newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin to sell insurance arm stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: Serfin to sell insurance arm stake - paper.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Serfin plans to sell a minority stake in its insurance arm, Seguros Serfin, for about $150 million to a foreign partner, the daily newspaper Reforma said Monday.
Serfin officials were not available for comment on the report.
The sale of 49 percent of the insurance division should take place in mid-June, the article said, citing unnamed Serfin sources. Payment would be part cash, part against results.
Serfin has begun negotiations with two U.S. insurers and one European insurer, the newspaper said. It did not name the possible buyers.
Reforma said that after the sale, Serfin plans to raise $350 million through a stock offer or by placing convertible bonds or equity notes.
